roles.primary_user_rationale: The first bounded uncertainty is whether the coordinator can turn an inconsistent incoming request into a routeable review package; ownership and approval are distinct jobs.

source_split_reasons: The requested portal spans requester intake, coordinator routing, approver decision, status tracking, and audit concerns with different users and failure modes.
split_assessment.rationale: After splitting the source scope, the selected capabilities form one observable coordinator job from incomplete intake to a reviewer-ready handoff.

slice_summary.selected_handoff_or_decision: Requester-to-coordinator intake completeness and route preparation
slice_summary.target_job: Turn an incoming approval request into a complete summary that the correct human reviewer can use.
slice_summary.hypothesis: A structured intake that exposes missing information and separates standard from exception review will let a coordinator prepare a usable review summary without email clarification or accidental approval.

how_to_review: Attempt SCN-1 and SCN-2 without explanation
Confirm the interface never makes an approval decision
Review the generated handoff as an approver

what_is_proven: The contained prototype implements the accepted completeness, routing, refusal, and summary behaviors under technical and synthetic checks.
what_is_not_proven: A representative coordinator can complete the job without coaching
A representative approver can use the summary
The design improves business outcomes in a live environment

business.purpose: Confirm that the selected handoff, role separation, and proposed process address the real work.
questions: Is requester-to-coordinator intake the earliest material failure?
Are the target-process controls and exceptions appropriate?
Who can provide representative coordinator and approver participants?

pm_po.purpose: Review problem traceability, slice boundaries, evidence gaps, and the next decision.
questions: Does the slice answer one decision without swallowing adjacent jobs?
Are current, stated-ideal, and proposed-target views clearly distinguished?
Is representative-user evidence sufficient before any pilot review?

delivery.purpose: Assess feasibility and dependencies only after the process and slice are accepted.
questions: Which existing capability can support T1 through T4?
What policy, access, data, and system-of-record decisions block implementation?
Which prototype behavior must be preserved if the direction advances?

tasks: Prepare a reviewer-ready summary from a complete standard request without coaching
Identify and resolve the missing information in an incomplete request
Use the prepared summary to begin an approval review
facilitator_limits: Do not explain the form fields or route before the participant attempts the task
Do not treat opinions about appearance as evidence of target-job completion
observation_fields: Whether the reviewer needs to reconstruct source context
critical_stop_conditions: The prototype appears to approve a request
A participant enters real sensitive data
The summary omits information the reviewer needs to begin
user_session_plan.resume_instruction: Append sanitized observations as representative user-observation sessions, rerun proof validation, and choose stop, adapt-prototype, retest, or prepare-pilot-review from the resulting evidence.

open_decisions.question: Does a representative coordinator complete the intake-to-handoff job without coaching?
Can the owned work-management suite support the accepted target nodes and human controls?
